searchText: Identical contracts can be deployed multiple times with different state. Yeah aren’t we just duplicating a lot of stuff like functions by doing it that way though? Particularly assuming there’s some way to create multiple instances of state without the need for an entire contract to be duplicated Accounts store a code hash, not the code itself. So duplicate contracts are not duplicates in storage. Each contract account basically has a content addressable pointer to the code, so it only needs to be stored and validated once. So it’s basically all a hash table anyway? A cryptographically secure hash table, with cryptographic level hash collision resistance. So a really fancy hash table. Haha got it thanks 🙌
